source: TNAU Agritech Portal and Government agricultural guidance; verify region-specific advice before production use

healthy.name: Healthy leaf
prevention: Inspect both sides of leaves weekly
Keep tools and nursery material clean
management: Remove badly damaged leaves from the field
healthy.expertWhen: Consult an expert if spots, wilt, or rapid yellowing appears across multiple plants.

bacterial_leaf_blight.name: Bacterial leaf blight
symptoms: Yellowing that moves inward from the margin
prevention: Use clean seed and avoid working in wet foliage
Maintain field drainage and balanced nitrogen
management: Remove heavily affected leaves where practical
Use only locally approved, label-directed products after expert confirmation
bacterial_leaf_blight.expertWhen: Contact a local agriculture officer when symptoms spread beyond one patch or reach the flag leaf.

leaf_blast.name: Leaf blast
symptoms: Lesions may join and dry large areas of the leaf
prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen and keep spacing open
management: Remove volunteer plants and crop residue where appropriate
Follow local integrated disease management guidance
leaf_blast.expertWhen: Seek expert advice before treatment if lesions appear near the neck or panicle.
